text:
sarah_cs: Hi team — NovusBio asked for a focused 90-minute "quantization clinic" next week to prep their models for Dedicated. They specifically called out latency regressions after int8 conversion and want hands-on guidance. Proposed slots: Tue 10–11:30am PT, Wed 2–3:30pm PT, or Thu 9–10:30am PT. Agenda draft below. Can we lock a slot and confirm instructors?

sarah_cs: Agenda (draft):
1) 10m — quick kickoff, goals and success criteria
2) 25m — overview: quantization strategies and tradeoffs (post-training vs PTQ vs QAT)
3) 30m — live demo: converting a 7B LLM to int8 and running perf checks on Dedicated config
4) 20m — troubleshooting: common failure modes and calibration tips
5) 5m — next steps + follow-up resources

miguel_se: Tue looks good for infra availability, but I have a colo deployment test running then. Wed 2pm PT is safest for me. I can lead the live demo and bring a small repro repo.

miguel_se: Also want to confirm NovusBio model family + typical sequence lengths. If they're mostly <=512 tokens we can demo a faster kernel path.

priya_novusbio: Wed 2pm PT works for our side. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Our primary model is `novus-7b-v2` fine-tuned for summarization, tokens avg ~360. We also have a 3B experimental model that we might try if time permits.

leah_enablements: Wed 2pm is fine for me too. I can prepare a short slide deck on measurement methodology and an eval checklist we can leave with them.

jordan_ops: Wed 2–3:30pm PT tentatively blocked on calendars. Zoom + recording enabled, will send calendar invite once confirmed. Need the meeting title and attendee list (we should include Dedicated SRE on standby).

priya_novusbio: Please include our infra lead Sam (sam_novusbio) and ML engineer Arjun (arjun_novusbio). I'll DM their emails.

miguel_se: For the demo I'll need: a small sample checkpoint (or a public model link), a representative input file with ~50 examples, and permission to run a quick Dedicated job using a dev GPU pool. Can Novus share those ahead of Wed EOD?

priya_novusbio: I'll upload a sanitized checkpoint to the S3 link you shared last week by tomorrow EOD. Sample inputs also attached to the doc I just shared.

leah_enablements: Quick note — we should include a short pre-read telling them how to capture perf logs (token-level latency + GPU utilization) so we can hit the ground running. I'll draft and share in #cs-resources.

miguel_se: Perfect. Plan for the live demo: run conversion script (3–5min), run a quick perf sweep (8–10min), then iterate on calibration knobs (15–20min). If we run out of time we'll capture steps and follow up with a recorded deep-dive.

jordan_ops: Calendar-bot: created meeting "NovusBio — Quantization Clinic (Wed 2pm PT)" for Wed 1767200000. Invitees: sarah_cs, miguel_se, leah_enablements, priya_novusbio, sam_novusbio, arjun_novusbio. Zoom link: https://zoom.example/abc123 :white_check_mark:

priya_novusbio: Thanks all. One ask — can you also cover fallback strategies if int8 causes quality drops? We need practical rollback steps.

miguel_se: Absolutely. I'll include rollback checklist and a quick script to switch model routes to a float16 variant via the Redwood routing policy. Example snippet I'll show:```yaml
route: novus-prod
fallback_policy:
  - model: novus-7b-v2-fp16
    priority: 1
  - model: novus-7b-v2-int8
    priority: 2
```

leah_enablements: I'll add a one-page cheat sheet with the rollback commands and where to check quality regressions in Console.

sarah_cs: Great — we're all set for Wed 2pm PT. Action items: Miguel upload demo repo (by Tue EOB), Priya upload checkpoint and samples (by Tue EOB), Leah share pre-read and cheat sheet (by Tue EOB), Jordan will send calendar invite (done).

priya_novusbio: Confirmed — see you Wed. :rocket:

miguel_se: Thanks — I'll post the repo link in this thread when ready.

calendar-bot: event updated: "NovusBio — Quantization Clinic" recording enabled, transcript ON.
